notes.title: New Offline Mode added in the latest update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/edbae03923233c3995584ccaefcfc7c5d1c45c67.png[/img]
The Warhammer Skulls Festival is over for another year and we want to thank all our [i]Warhammer Underworlds: Online[/i] alumni as well as all our new [i]Shadespire Edition[/i] players that joined us for the event!

[h3]Exalted Ladder Reset[/h3]
Many online battles were completed over the week, with a slate of new players climbing the rankings to exalted status! As Skulls '23 has ended, so the exalted masters have been toppled from their lofty thrones, with the removal of any inactive players. Those players that have not logged into the game since the start of the Skulls event are classed as inactive and are removed from the ladder, and had their rank reduced to 5 as per the usual season reset rules.

This opens up possibilities for new and old players to rise the ranks and join the exalted leaderboard! Can you battle your way through the Mirrored City and join the chosen few?

[h3]Skulls 2023 cardback[/h3]
If you jump into the 'Cosmetics' section of the Deck Builder, you'll see a shiny new Skulls 2023 card back! Once again thank you for taking part in this year's Skulls event - we hope to see you next year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/f37150a28385595988cfc7849fe5515505fbc68e.png[/img]

[h3]Offline Mode[/h3]
And finally! Due to popular demand we've implemented a new offline mode that is selectable at the start of the game for those who prefer, or need, to be off the grid for their gaming. 

Please note that 'offline mode' only includes bot matches and single-player challenges, and some content unlocking rewards are not available. Also any progress made in 'offline mode' will NOT be sychronised with 'online mode'.

[i]Make sure to update your game on Steam before jumping online. Note: You should see 1.8.8 in-game once you have the update.

And as always be sure to verify your files through Steam if you get any weird crashes, hangs or invisible fighters[/i]

notes.title: Patch 073: Lying in Wait - 02/22/2022
notes.content:
[b]Queue Notifications (BETA)[/b]
We’re trialing a new notification feature that alerts you of online matches if you're in a bot match, challenge match or building decks in the deck builder! We’ve added a handy pop-up where you’ll be notified when another player enters into matchmaking! In settings there's a “Queue Notifications (BETA)” setting already enabled.[i] If you don't want to use this feature make sure you disable it.[/i] 

Here’s how it will work:

[list]
[*] If you’re in a single player game then you’ll be given the option to join the queue, and you’ll only be removed from your current game if the match is found. You’ll then have the option to choose a deck before connecting. Unfortunately we won’t be able to save your single player game state.
[*] If you’re outside of a game, for instance building a deck, you’ll be told whenever a player enters matchmaking, and you’ll need to navigate to the “Play Online” button. This will allow you to save your deck before joining.
[*] Joining from the notification puts you in the “First Available” queue.
[/list]
[i]If you decide to trial this feature please let us know your thoughts so we can improve it![/i]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Using Flit over occupied cells no longer makes them unselectable
[*] Mollog's Mob selection issues fixed
[/list]

[b]Note: You should see 1.8.3 in-game once you have the update. Make sure to update your game on Steam before jumping online. [/b]

[i]As always be sure to verify the integrity of your files through Steam if you get any weird crashes, hangs or invisible fighters![/i]

notes.title: The Mob has arrived!
notes.content:
Easily the biggest, strongest, and meanest fighter in all the underworlds, Mollog the Mighty can hammer all comers with his fearsome club! Joining him are a mob of the bizarre denizens that once dwelt in his beloved cave beneath the dunes of the Desert of Bones.

Mollog had to abandon his mushroom-littered cavern after an infestation of Skaven, and has wandered into the ruins of Shadespire. This means YOU can now take control of the powerful Troggoth, an incredibly fast Bat Squig, a self-detonating Spiteshroom and an immovable Stalagsquig!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/8de33bc84a9176200f8a9e5ebcf8241ff2c2ffeb.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824460/Warhammer_Underworlds_Online__Warband_Mollogs_Mob

The latest update not only introduces [i]Mollog's Mob[/i] into the online fray, but also allows you to access three new Challenge paths for [i]Garrek's Reavers[/i], [i]Eyes of the Nine[/i], and of course, [i]Mollog's Mo[/i]b.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/053dc4681f595e55ea147cce3236ea445d39e167.jpg[/img]

Winning a Challenge unlocks the subsequent Challenge. If you score enough Glory you earn a new portrait for that warband (this can be added to your deck for online play). Score enough Glory across all the Challenges and you'll unlock a special skin for that warband too!

Not only that, but even if you don't own the DLC associated with that warband Challenge, you'll still be able to play the first two Challenges. A great way to try out a warband that you don't own!

[b]Note: You should see 1.8.0 in-game once you have the most recent update.[/b]

notes.title: New Challenges Await in the Mirrored City!
notes.content:
Welcome to [i]Warhammer Underworlds: Online[/i]'s new single player [b]Challenges[/b]. It's time to break the rules of the game and let your warbands run riot! The foes may seem familiar, but the rules and scenarios are very different. Complete Challenges, unlock new artwork and skins, and experience [i]Warhammer Underworlds[/i] in a new way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/e9ab5af09f6191c8752ea6ea65641b1cbeffbfd3.png[/img]

The rules of the Challenges are pretty simple:

[list]
[*]Each warband has six Challenges each.
[*]When a Challenge is completed, players will unlock the next Challenge!
[*]All players have access to the first two Challenges for each warband, regardless of whether they have purchased the DLC.
[*]Should a player complete the second Challenge, they need to purchase that warband as DLC to unlock Challenges 3 to 6.
[*]Each Challenge has three special Objective Glory Tokens to win:
[olist]
[*]Defeating an opponent by scoring more Glory than the opponent by the end of Round 3.
[*]Scoring at least three Objective Cards in a match.
[*]Scoring at least six Objective Cards in a match.[/olist]
[*]Once all three Objective Glory Tokens are collected, players will unlock the player portrait connected with that Challenge.
[*]Objective Glory Tokens will also count towards unlocking a new skin for that warband. Collecting twelve of those Tokens will unlock a new skin for that warband!
[*]For each Challenge, players start with 9 Objective Cards in their hand.
[*]Opponents start with a fixed number of Glory but no Objective Cards.
[*]The player's Power Card deck is fixed and will come out in the same order each time.
[*]The opponent's Power Card deck is randomised.
[/list]
[i]PLEASE NOTE:  The Challenges mode is in beta, but feature complete for three warbands: Magore's Fiends, Ironskull's Boyz and The Farstriders! The descriptions are also available only in English at this stage. [/i]


This patch also contains a number of new features and bug fixes. Here are the patch notes:

[/list]

[*] Massive Assault now counts spell damage

[i]Make sure to update your game on Steam before jumping online. Note: You should see 1.7.8 in-game once you have the update. And as always be sure to verify your files through Steam if you get any weird crashes, hangs or invisible fighters.[/i]

notes.title: Patch 039: Changing the Rules of Engagement
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we've just pushed out a new update! 

[h3]Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rules updates
[*] Restricted list

[b]Make sure to update your game on Steam for those changes to come into effect. You should see 1.4.1 in-game once you have the update.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/676596fbf33d9299121c3ddd0d4b2dba54968275.png[/img]

[h3]Rules Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] Guard: Fighters on Guard can no longer be driven back
[*] Initial roll off: The roll off at the start of the game allows the winner to choose who places their board first
[*] Lethal hexes: Hexes that will damage whoever moves into them, either through push, knockback, movement etc. Placeable during board placement.
[*] Super Actions: ‘Charging’ and ‘Scything’ attacks are considered Super Actions. Inspiring and scoring objectives will now take place after Super Actions are completed
[*] Surge: There is a Surge Limit of no more than 6 Surge Objectives per deck (“Score Immediately” Objectives)
[*] Restricted list: Players are able to have a maximum of 5 Restricted Cards in their Deck (see below)
[/list]
 
[h3]Restricted list[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Objectives:[/b] Advancing Strike, Alone in the Darkness, Change of Tactics, Defensive Strike, Escalation, Precise Use of Force, Sorcerous Scouring
[*] [b]Gambits:[/b] Illusory Fighter, My Turn, Ready for Action, Trap, Twist the Knife, Sudden Appearance
[*] [b]Upgrades:[/b] A Destiny to Meet, Awakened Weapon, Deathly Fortitude, Helpful Whispers, Incredible Strength, Shadeglass Dagger, Shadeglass Hammer, Soultrap
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Zharkus’ Gorefist will no longer trigger when Trapped
[*] Updated combat log text to include healing text
[*] Fixed Steady Volley’s interaction with Piercing Stare
[*] Fixed My Turn’s interaction with Shattering Terrain
[*] Fixed an issue where the game over screen would appear twice
[*] Fixed an issue where ‘Shadeglass weapon’ upgrades would not discard themselves when used
[*] Various ‘attack again’ ploys will no longer trigger after Expendable (Tireless Assault, Oathsworn, Necromancer Commands, Endless Malice and Eidetic Memory)
[*] Living Wall will no longer cause the game to freeze if there are not enough friendly living fighters on the battlefield
[*] Various stability improvements
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Living Wall can still be played with only one fighter on the field, but will not have any effect
[*] Lethal Hexes sometimes do not visually highlight during drivebacks or pushes (they can still be selected)
[*] Confusion fails to apply damage when a fighter is swapped into a Lethal Hex
[/list]


[b]Note: You should see 1.4.1 in-game once you have the update.[/b]

Once you’ve hit Rank 1, the fight to be the very best isn’t over. Beyond this top rank, you’ll be titled Exalted and Warhammer Underworlds: Online will show you a new number that represents your ranking in relation to other players that have also become Exalted. [b][h3]Queue Changes[/h3][/b]

On startup, you’ll notice a change to the way you play matches in Warhammer Underworlds: Online. We don’t want to split those looking for games into two separate queues, so to reduce wait times, Casual and Ranked queues have been merged into a single queue, now called Play Online.

[h3]Settings Update [/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img]We've reworked the settings system backend and added a number of new graphics settings. Some settings are divided into sub-groups. Click on the drop down arrows on a group to see the options inside.

[b][h3]Reconnection System[/h3] [/b]
This system is in a beta phase. Our initial goal is to support players who have client crashes, and players who are disconnected due to server issues.[list]
[*] Getting disconnected during a match will take you back to the main menu and will only give the option to 'Reconnect' to the same match. Pressing this option will make the client try to reconnect to the server you were dropped from.
[*]  The server will continue to the match after a player has disconnected. It will stay active for three timeouts by the disconnected player. If that player doesn't reconnect in that period, it will grant a concede victory to the remaining player.
[*]  Disconnecting during board setup or re-drawing your hand is still counted as a concede, only disconnecting during or after fighter placement will enable the reconnection system. 
[*]  You cannot reconnect to bot matches.
[/list]

[b][h3]UI Clarity[/h3][/b]
We're working on clarifying a lot of in-game info, one of the key steps in this is showing more valuable information on fighter HUDs. [list]
[*] Added Move and Defence characteristics to fighter HUDs.
[*] Added popup text when a fighter’s attacks have a special effect, such as Cleave, Trapped, or Ignore Knockback. 
[*] New fighter HUD visualisation for the number of upgrades a fighter has.
[/list]

[b][h3]Card Fixes[/h3][/b][list]
[*] On Your Feet no longer removes Shardgale damage from other fighters.
[*] On Your Feet now allows you to choose a target if there is more than one valid target fighter.
[*] My Turn no longer triggers if the potential target is dying.
[*] Multiple cards that applied +1 damage were stacking incorrectly during attack reaction chains. We have reworked the effects for these cards so they are individually applied, instead of having a generic '+1 Damage' effect.
[*] Lightning Strikes now only triggers off of the specific charge-attack.
[*] Stopped Reflected Injury from triggering with dead fighters.
[*] Updated Scything attacks to check if they should be canceled by Maddening Cackle.
[*] Multiple consecutive Gorefist reactions no longer lock the game. This is the first part of a reaction rework where reaction cards won't run their own effect logic, meaning cards that can react to their own effects (eg. Gorefist vs Gorefist) won't stop after the first effect or get bugged.
[/list]

notes.content:

[/i]
[b]Note: You should see 0.7.1 in-game once you have the update.[u] THIS IS A BIG UPDATE[/u] so there might be a delay on progression content while we update the servers. [/b]
[h3][b]Highlights[/b][/h3]
[b]- New warband: Spiteclaw’s Swarm
- New feature: Progression
- Tutorials
- Bug fixes[/b]
[h3][b]New Warband: Spiteclaw's Swarm[/b][/h3]
As announced in one of our previous streams and on our Discord, we are adding another warband to our roster! We know how much you’ve wanted this. The sixth warband to be included in [i]Warhammer Underworlds: Online[/i] is your favourite Ratmen - the Skaven’s very own Spiteclaw’s Swarm.

For additional information about Spiteclaw's Swarm, follow this link.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1022310/partnerevents/view/2092426528678266436

[h3][b]Progression[/b][/h3] 
We have added an initial pass of a faction progression system. Each warband will have a track of unlockable cosmetics. The player will unlock these by gaining experience from matches. Winning a match gives the most XP, losses give less, and concedes give no XP to the conceding player.
[list]
[*] Unlockables! Added unlockable warband skins, player titles, and deck portraits
[*] Implemented a new menu area  for seeing warband-specific progression tracks
[*] Added Cosmetic tabs to the deck builder to equip player titles and deck portraits
[*] Added game statistic tracking, which can be found in the progression menu
[/list]

[b]Tutorial[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img]- Tutorials have been updated to be clearer and more explanatory
- Added Tutorial #3 which takes players through a complete match

[b]Environment[/b]
- Matches will now randomise their environment

[b]Timeouts[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img]- Implemented concession by timeout: If a player has 3 consecutive timeouts, the server will concede the match and the other player will win

[h3]Bug Fixes & Small Changes[/h3]
[b]General Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed some networking issues that were causing player's decisions to crash the game. The server will now wait for a response from the player that they have started a decision before starting the timer

[b]Card Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img] Fixed a bug where No Respite could crash a match
[*] Invisible Walls now only affects base movement characteristic, instead of affecting other modifiers
[*] Second Wind no longer continues triggering after round end
[*] Fixed multiple cards that had 'On Crit' effects that wouldn't go off on re-rolled Crits, such as Shadeglass Spear, Starfalcon, Lightning Blade, Focused Attack & Hakka/Basha
[*] Fixed a bug where killing a fighter with Lightning Blast causes a non-progression
[*] Fixed Daemonic Resilience not working when trapped 
[*] Fixed More Able Bodies and Lives are Cheap from being unable to score if they aren't scored first 
[*] Invisible Walls now discards at the start of the Power Phase, and also only affects base movement value, not upgraded values
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img]No Respite, Fatal Strike, and Last Lunge now only trigger post-damage increment. This should fix all previous issues of these cards triggering when enemy fighters weren't going to die 
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img]Updated Gorefist, Furious Blow, and Fatal Riposte to check if the attacker is dead before the Reaction goes off
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Spiteclaw’s Swarm upgrade card Expendable will be added when it is functioning and stable. For now, it has not been included
[*] The Spiteclaw's Swarm ploy card Momentary Boldness can cause a non-progression if the player using it allows it to time out when choosing and confirming their Charge action
[*] Tutorials are currently not localised - we have translations on the way for all supported languages
[*] Player rank text currently does not display changes in rank. Your rank does change behind the scenes, though
[*] Cancelling out of matchmaking too quickly will take you to the progression screen. If you select matchmaking again it will force you to the progression screen constantly. Restarting the app should stop this, and it won't happen if you are on the matchmaking screen for more than a few seconds
[*] If a player concedes due to timeouts, the winner's victory screen won't show the UI. Returning to the main menu should return everything to normal, and this bug doesn't affect progression/stat recording
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Patch 007: Gathering the Shards
notes.content:
[h3][b]Highlights[/b][/h3]
- Glossary Improvements
- Tutorial Prompts for new players
- Rollover Fighter Name Plates
- Bug Fixes


[h3][b]Glossary Improvements[/b][/h3]
We’re continuing to make improvements to the Glossary. This week we have added two things; hyperlinks to allow related glossary entries to link to each other, and more images and animations to help illustrate the core game concepts more clearly.


[h3][b]Tutorial Prompts for new players[/b][/h3]
When first time players start up the game they will immediately be prompted to play through our tutorials. Experienced players (or those who like to take a more “immersive” approach to learning the game) can still choose to skip these tutorials.

[h3][b]Phase Labels[/b][/h3]
To help new players (and assist experienced ones) we’ve added additional labels that let you know exactly what phase of the game you are currently in. 

[h3][b]Rollover Fighter Name Plates[/b][/h3]
We’ve hidden the nameplates above each fighter to help declutter the battlefield and make it easier to see and select your fighters. Wound counts and team markers are still visible, and if you do forget a fighters name simply roll your cursor over a fighter and their name will popup.

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img] Sepulchral Guard Ploy - “Swift Evasion”: Fixed an issue where players would be allowed to select fighters that could not be pushed further from enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img] Sepulchral Guard Objective - “March of the Dead”: Fixed an issue where Universal Ploy - “Hidden Paths” would not count towards scoring this objective. “Hidden Paths” can now be used to help score “March of the Dead”.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img] Universal Objective - “Crushing Force”: Now checks damage AFTER all modifiers are applied (Lethal Strike, Gorkamorka’s Blessing, etc.) to determine if this objective can be scored.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img] Universal Ploy - “Lethal Strike”: Fixed an issue where this card was not providing double damage when interrupted mid attack (by cards such as Ironskull’s - “Last Lunge” or Universal - “Fuelled by Fury”). 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img] Universal Ploy - “Lethal Strike”: Also fixed an issue where this card was doubling damage AFTER modifiers, when it should only double the base damage characteristic of the attack next used.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img] Universal Ploy - “Teamwork”: Now updates the calculated Support totals after the push is complete (and before the attack starts).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img] Ironskull’s Boyz Upgrade - “Dead Ard’”: Fixed an issue where this upgrade would sometimes only work the first time the equipped fighter was attacked, but then never again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img] Ironskull’s Boyz Objective - “Good Scrap”: Fixed issue where this Objective was being scored based on the number of fighters taken out during the ENTIRE game, instead of just the last Action Phase. This card now functions correctly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img] Sepulchral Guard Objective “More Able Bodies”: Fixed issue where this Objective was ALSO being scored based on the number of fighters taken out during the ENTIRE game, instead of just the last Action Phase. This card now functions correctly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img] Universal Objective - “Honest Opponent”: Now tracks the amount of ploys played during a round while still in the Objective Deck (this prevents it from scoring incorrectly if a player draws it mid round after playing a number of ploys).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img] Magore’s Fiends Upgrade - “No Respite”: Was incorrectly allowing players to Charge when the equipped fighter was taken out. It also correctly checks which enemy fighters are in range for an attack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img] Overly Board: Fixed a visual issue where “Choose Board” would briefly pop up while player is connecting/launching a game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34958388/79755266276957436f0e31d7cf73b64407104644.png[/img] Concessions of a Katophrane (Trapped in the Mirror City!): Fixed a number of issues around players conceding matches then their opponents being forced to continue playing or also concede themselves.

- [b]Universal Objective - “Complete Victory”[/b]: now checks for the number of fighters taken out at the End Phase. Previously these cards would track each TO during the game which didn’t account for resurrected fighters or fighters that narrowly avoid getting stomped (looking at you Gurzag equipped with “Unkillable”!).

- [b]Universal Objective - “Chosen Champion”[/b]: accidently required 3 or more fighters to be alive before it could be scored. This has been fixed.

- [b]Universal Objective - “Ploymaster”[/b]: now tracks the number of ploys played during a round while still in the Objective Deck (allowing it to score correctly if drawn mid-round).
- [b]Universal Objective - “Massive Assault”[/b]: now tracks the amount of damage done during a round while still in the Objective Deck (allowing it to score correctly if drawn mid-round).

- [b]Magore’s Fiends - “All the better to Slay Them”[/b]: should score correctly now that it checks if it's scorable after knockback and push events.

- [b]Match Made in Shadespire 2 (The Matchening): [/b]More fixes for bugs relating to the issue where cancelling out of a matchmaking queue might affect your ability to enter online matches. It turns out this was not just one bug but many that we needed to squash, so if you have any symptoms relating to this matchmaking issue, please post an in-game bug report, quit the match, and restart the application to clear the data. 
Symptoms include:

        - Players being stuck on the Board Setup screen after choosing a board
        - Players being stuck waiting for opponents to load into the 3D Match environment.

notes.title: 0.1.0 - Closed Beta Notes
notes.content:
We have launched the closed beta! Here's some tips to help you with starting up a match.

[b]Controls:[/b]
[list]
[*] To control the camera, click and drag either Left Mouse or Middle Mouse.
[*] The player button - in the center of the bottom part of the screen - has different functions at different phases of the game. It is used to pass power phases, skip your turn, skip sections of the end phase, and select the player that will begin fighter placement or activations. To use this button, either click on it or press the Spacebar key.
[*] To select highlighted options - fighters, cells or the player button - click Left Mouse
[*] To use a card, click and drag the card to the middle of the screen using Left Mouse
[*] Some cards can be dragged to a target position on the boards - an example would be fighter placement, where you must click and drag the fighter card to the targeted starting point using Left Click. This will be implemented for more cards in the future.
[*] To activate a fighter, click them during your activation and click and drag the action token you wish to do from their token tray to the targeted point, eg. drag the 'Move' token to the point you wish to move to. If a fighter is not able to be activated, their will not be able to be selected during activation.
[*] During activation, after selecting a fighter, you can select a cell in range of movement to put a waypoint. The fighter will path through all waypoints for movement or charging.
[*] After selecting a fighter, charging can be done by selecting the targeted enemy and dragging an attack to them, OR by simply dragging the attack to the targeted enemy. This will try to move the fighter to the closest move point in range, based on the position of the cursor on the targeted enemy. This can be a bit fiddly so watch out that you don't move to the wrong point!
[/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Support symbols are not implemented correctly in the current build. The number of supporting fighters will make those respective dice symbols successes, instead of subtracting the smaller number of support from the larger and formulating success symbols from that. This was implemented in this format for a proof of concept and hasn't been reworked since, it will be fixed before release.
[*] Some UI messages are not implemented, will show their localisation key.
[*] Disconnecting during matchmaking / server connection can cause instability or visual bugs.
[*] Some upgrades do not appear in the fighter's token tray.
[*] There is a networking issue during some matches that will cause a player's board to generate incorrectly. This appears as little 'charge' symbols over the top of each cell on that board. This will crash the match, so you will need to exit the match and queue for matchmaking again. This should be a rare occurence.
[*] The audio settings are defaulted to 0. To change this, open the settings panel by clicking on the settings symbol in the top left of the screen, and move the audio sliders to an appropriate level.
[*] There are some issues with the tutorials that may cause non-progressions.
[*] Users receiving false error messages when attempting to report a bug.
[/list]

[b]Setting your profile name[/b]
You can set your profile name by clicking on your profile icon in the top right of the main menu screen. This will open the profile window, where you can link your steam and discord accounts, and/or sign up using an email to make a custom name.

If you encounter any further additional issues, let us know on our Discord: https://discord.gg/wuogame

Any further updates, make sure to join the Discord and add Warhammer Underworlds Online to your wishlists!!
